audit_metadata.audit_name: H4 Foldseek TM-Score Anomaly & Sensitivity Audit
audit_metadata.auditor: Antigravity Data-Validity Audit Engine (Gemini Flash 3.8 High)
audit_metadata.scope: Comprehensive census of all raw Foldseek output files in H4 pipeline

root_cause_analysis.buggy_code: tmres = tmaligner->computeTMscore(targetCaData, &targetCaData[res.dbLen], &targetCaData[res.dbLen+res.dbLen], res.dbLen, res.qStartPos, res.dbStartPos, tmpBt, std::min(res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos, res.dbEndPos - res.dbStartPos));
root_cause_analysis.mechanism: Off-by-one residue error in denominator normalization length for alntmscore. In Foldseek, res.qStartPos and res.qEndPos are 0-indexed inclusive bounds (e.g. residues 0 to 99 for a 100-residue segment). The true span length is res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos + 1 = 100. The code passes res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos = 99, underestimating alignment length by exactly 1 residue (L_norm = L_ali - 1). For nearly identical structural alignments (RMSD -> 0), the unnormalized TM sum approaches L_ali, and dividing by (L_ali - 1) produces alntmscore = L_ali / (L_ali - 1) > 1.0 (e.g. 1.001 to 1.014).
root_cause_analysis.qtm_and_ttm_immunity: qtmscore and ttmscore normalize by res.qLen (query full length) and res.dbLen (target full length) respectively (lines 903 and 908). Because alignment length can never exceed full sequence length, qtmscore and ttmscore can never exceed 1.00000. In 100% of the 6,845,932 audited rows, qtmscore <= 0.9979 and ttmscore <= 0.9976.
root_cause_analysis.upstream_lead_correlation: Matches Steineggerlab GitHub issue #578 where a user reported alntmscore > 1.0 with alignment-type 1. Unrelated to issue #312 (column format overwrite).

cohort_and_query_impact.scientific_rationale_for_cohort_isolatio: The off-by-one alntmscore inflation requires an alignment TM-sum >= L_ali - 1, which only occurs when structural alignment is near-identical (RMSD < 0.5 A, true TM > 0.99). Positive controls (KF* queries) are known PDB structures with identical or near-identical crystal counterparts in the PDB search database. Dark matter models, by definition, lack high-identity structural matches in the PDB, making it mathematically impossible for any dark matter query to reach the required near-unity score threshold to trigger the bug.

arm_B_exclusion_sensitivity.filter_applied: Exclude all rows where alntmscore > 1.00001 (drop 2,194 rows out of 6,845,932)

dark_matter_cohort_impact.scientific_conclusion: Zero impact across all 280 cells of the dark matter 8-strata x 5-tier census table. All dark matter classifications, match counts, recovery rates, and transitions are 100.00% identical.

tiers_2_to_4_changes.description: Dropping anomalous rows causes 3 to 8 controls to lose their sole remaining hit below identity thresholds (<30%, <25%, <20%), shifting them to POST_EXCLUSION_EMPTY.
tiers_2_to_4_changes.statistical_inference: Control recovery and retention rates remain overwhelmingly high (>92.5%), preserving all statistical significance tests and paper conclusions.

results.tmalign_compiler_warning: warning: user assigned length should be >= minimum length of the two structures, otherwise TM-score may be >1

audit_recommendations.immediate_data_validity_bound: For automated pipeline audits, assert alntmscore in [0.0, 1.0200] (or 1.0 + 1.0 / (min_span - 1)) while strictly maintaining qtmscore in [0.0, 1.00001] and ttmscore in [0.0, 1.00001].
audit_recommendations.upstream_code_fix: In Foldseek structureconvertalis.cpp line 898, change std::min(res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos, res.dbEndPos - res.dbStartPos) to std::min(res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos + 1, res.dbEndPos - res.dbStartPos + 1).
audit_recommendations.scientific_pipeline_action: Do NOT alter baseline H4 results or rerun the pipeline. Primary H4 classifications are strictly based on qtmscore (qtm >= 0.5), which is mathematically immune to the anomaly and exhibits zero violations across all 6.84M rows. Sensitivity analysis proves dark matter results are 100.00% invariant.
